plugins.name: atlanai-analytics
plugins.description: Build an agent that answers your data questions, on a demo or your own data: I extract the context in your dashboards and past queries, add detailed information to it and validate it, then you store it here or save it to Atlan Trident, ask it questions and build a dashboard.

plugins.name: atlanai-mods
plugins.description: Claude Code mod for Atlan Trident: Atlan Trident reads run without a prompt, writes ask first, archive and move show what depends on the artifact, temporary gateway errors tell Claude how to retry, Atlan calls read as one line in the transcript, a pane lists what the session touched, a band follows a skill publish, /atlan skills picks a skill to load, an Atlan Trident skill that clearly fits a request is named to Claude, and the status line reports a broken or degraded Atlan connection.
